title: Track 3 data-universe completion checklist

records.next_blocker: Successful retrieval and row-level preservation of the current Public Queue Report and historical cluster/serial workbooks.

records.next_blocker: Enumerate public Batch Zero/RIOO submissions where the underlying response is actually public.

records.what_is_published: 3,076-row active public GI queue and dedicated HILL process/source layer.
records.next_blocker: Extract discrete HILL/customer records when public study/service documents expose them.

records.what_is_published: 21 named/crosswalked Load Project site records plus 31 Gold Book load records; current complete queue snapshot file is not present on main.
records.next_blocker: Successful retrieval of the official workbook and full site crosswalk.

records.what_is_published: Two forecast large-load project records and source-level CELT material.
records.next_blocker: Recover project-specific study/service milestones from filings where public.

records.what_is_published: All 28 retained Data Load project rows have project ID, project name, public planning-area/town, capacity/DTS and status; customer remains unknown when undisclosed.
records.next_blocker: Match the 28 project IDs to publicly named customers/proponents where evidence exists.

records.what_is_published: Six named current load/increase-load application records plus the 2,074-row application-status universe and OEB CCIM context.
records.next_blocker: Systematically crosswalk IESO/OEB/municipal evidence to facility identities and distribution connection records.

records.what_is_published: 253 project-level records, 253 mapped project display points, 63 aggregate/historical map footprints, and 58 supplemental evidence units.
records.next_blocker: Continue utility-by-utility docket/service/permit extraction and de-duplicate against organized-market queues.

accounting: Statuses describe public-data coverage, not whether the physical large-load universe itself is complete. No source is promoted to a facility row unless its identity and relevant fields are actually supported.
